verdict.rationale: Vanta is a SaaS compliance platform with its own AI features (the Vanta AI Agent and Vanta AI evidence review), so asking whether customer data can be excluded from AI model training is a fair question. The evidence pack has nothing on training data use, AI training opt-outs, or data-use policies for its AI features.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
